label: Safe Mode toggle
description: Persistent control that pauses animation, stops marquees, mutes audio, and raises contrast. Provided by the safety layer and required on every build.

label: Text-only version link
description: A plain link to a stripped, high-contrast version of the page. Period-correct and the main accessibility escape hatch.

label: Last updated stamp
description: A hand-typed or Timestamp-component date such as Last updated 3/14/98.

label: Plain mailto footer
description: An address element or webmaster line with a mailto link.

label: Email me graphic
description: An animated or static Email Me graphic wrapped in a mailto link.

label: Best viewed badge
description: Best viewed with a named browser at a named resolution. Use generic text or an original badge for client work.

label: Visible hit counter
description: Odometer digits such as You are visitor #004217.

label: Guestbook
description: Sign my guestbook page with dated visitor entries. Replaces testimonials.

label: Webring box
description: Bordered table with previous, next, random, and list links for a themed ring.

label: Under construction sign
description: Construction sign on unfinished sections. On FrontPage sites usually a single small GIF on a stub page.

label: Rainbow horizontal rule
description: A GIF divider used in place of the hr element.

label: Starry tiled background
description: Black, dark blue, or purple tile scattered with stars.

label: Neighborhood address
description: A themed homestead address such as SiliconValley/Heights/4021 matching the site topic.

label: What's New log
description: Dated update log with NEW graphics. On corporate sites it becomes Press Releases or News.

label: Click-to-play background music
description: A Turn on music control that plays a pre-rendered MIDI-style track only after a click.

label: Splash or Enter page
description: Logo plus an ENTER link before the real home page.

label: Cursor trail
description: DHTML sparkle or dot trail following the pointer. Disabled in Safe Mode.

label: Instant messenger handle
description: ICQ number or AIM screen name in place of chat or social links.

label: 88x31 button wall
description: A cluster of 88 by 31 pixel link buttons for friends, tools, and causes.

label: Status bar or text box scroller
description: Scrolling message, faked in a form text field or a styled status strip because browsers ignore window.status.

label: Shared borders
description: FrontPage-style top, left, and bottom regions repeated on every page.

label: Theme page banner
description: A themed banner graphic carrying the page title, generated per page.

label: Hover button navigation
description: Beveled nav buttons with a hover state, rebuilt as image swaps the way careful developers did after Java applets failed.

label: Search this site form
description: A small search form, FreeFind style on personal pages or the Search component on corporate pages.

label: Feedback form
description: Contact Us form with name, email, comments, and a gray Submit button.

label: Corporate copyright footer
description: Copyright, company, All rights reserved, and a Webmaster mailto.

label: Printer-friendly link
description: Printer-friendly version link, the period answer to alternate color schemes.

label: Broken component placeholder
description: A bracketed placeholder such as [Hit Counter] shown when a host lacked server extensions. A lived-in detail.

label: Frames or browser notice
description: This site uses frames or requires a newer browser notice, the period equivalent of a cookie banner.

label: Rotating banner ad
description: 468 by 60 rotating banner, originally a Java applet, rebuilt as an image swap.

label: Flash-style intro
description: Fixed 550 by 400 stage with an animated intro and Skip Intro link, rebuilt in HTML and CSS.

label: Portal modules
description: Weather, stocks, headlines, and My Page style boxes in a three-column table.

label: User CSS layout
description: A pasted style block that restyles the default profile tables. The layering is the point.

label: Profile blurbs
description: About Me and Who I'd Like to Meet sections.

label: Interests and Details tables
description: Interests rows and a Details table with status, hometown, and similar fields.

label: Contact table
description: Send Message, Add to Friends, Instant Message, and similar actions in a grid.

label: Top 8 friends
description: Grid of eight friend avatars with names. Replaces customer logo strips.

label: Comments wall
description: Friend comments with avatars, timestamps, and graphics such as Thanks for the add.

label: Profile song player
description: Small player box for the profile song, click to play only.

label: Glitter text
description: Sparkling animated text graphic for the display name or headings.

label: Blinkies
description: Small 150 by 20 animated text strips that declare likes and moods.

label: Online Now indicator
description: Small Online Now graphic next to the profile photo.

label: Profile views count
description: Profile Views count in plain text, the profile era replacement for the hit counter.

label: Custom cursor
description: Custom cursor image set through user CSS.
